_meta.notes: A target RP-1 is holding, which only its own Maintenance screen stands up. It halts warps and persists past the warp it stopped, so its readout and cancel sit beside the warp controls. Nothing here stops warp: RP-1's controller destroys itself the moment it sees a rate of zero, so the host widget's existing 1x button already ends an RP-1 warp.

_scene.caption: A fund target RP-1's own Maintenance screen stood up: its figure and RP-1's ETA, and the press that withdraws it. The balance alarm lives on the Finances tab.
